For algebraic spaces $Z\to B$ and $X\to B$ over $S$, the relative morphism functor $\operatorname{Mor}_B(Z,X)$ sends a scheme $T$ over $S$ to pairs $(a:T\to B,\ b:Z_T:=T\times_BZ\to X_T:=T\times_BX\text{ over }T)$. It is an fppf sheaf. For a base change $B'\to B$, write $Z'=B'\times_BZ$, $X'=B'\times_BX$; then the analogous relative functor $\operatorname{Mor}_{B'}(Z',X')$ is the pullback over $B'$.

Let $S$ be a scheme. Let $Z \to B$, $X \to B$, and $B' \to B$
be morphisms of algebraic spaces over $S$. Set $Z' = B' \times_B Z$
and $X' = B' \times_B X$. Then
$$
\mathit{Mor}_{B'}(Z', X')
=
B' \times_B \mathit{Mor}_B(Z, X)
$$
in $\operatorname{Sh}((\operatorname{Sch}/S)_{fppf})$.

It is an fppf sheaf. For a base change $B'\to B$, write $Z'=B'\times_BZ$, $X'=B'\times_BX$; then the analogous relative functor $\operatorname{Mor}_{B'}(Z',X')$ is the pullback over $B'$.

Let $S$ be a scheme. Let $Z \to B$ and $X' \to X \to B$ be morphisms of
algebraic spaces over $S$. Assume
\begin{enumerate}
\item $X' \to X$ is \'etale, and
\item $Z \to B$ is finite locally free.
\end{enumerate}
Then $\mathit{Mor}_B(Z, X') \to \mathit{Mor}_B(Z, X)$ is representable
by algebraic spaces and \'etale. If $X' \to X$ is also surjective,
then $\mathit{Mor}_B(Z, X') \to \mathit{Mor}_B(Z, X)$ is surjective.
